policy.note: Suggestions only. Nothing becomes an active stop until the operator confirms each entry. The risk engine stays BLOCKED until then.

holdings_confirmation_instructions: If (and only if) the positions in verified_current_holdings.json still exactly match your real book, set holdings_confirmed_current=true and holdings_confirmed_current_at to the current UTC timestamp; --apply-confirmed will then refresh run_date with provenance.

entries.operator_instructions: Review stop_loss (edit the number if you prefer your own level). To activate: set stop_loss_confirmed=true, stop_loss_confirmed_at to the current UTC timestamp, operator_confirmation_id to any identifier you choose, risk_acknowledgement=true, operator_confirmation_text to the EXACT string 'I_CONFIRM_THESE_STOPS_ARE_MY_OPERATOR_RISK_LIMITS'. Entries missing ANY of these are rejected by --apply-confirmed.
